# googleplay_converted_region_prices (Data Source)

Converts one price into the price of every region Google Play sells in, using today's exchange rates and each country's pricing patterns (`monetization.convertRegionPrices`). It is the API behind Play Console's "set prices" dialog.

~> **The result changes over time.** Exchange rates move, so wiring this data source straight into the `regional_configs` of a product makes its prices drift from one plan to the next. Use it to derive prices once and write them down, or accept the drift knowingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What Google Play would charge in every region for a 4.99 USD product, at
# today's exchange rates.
data "googleplay_converted_region_prices" "premium" {
  package_name = "com.example.app"

  price = {
    currency_code = "USD"
    amount        = "4.99"
  }
}

output "price_in_japan" {
  value = data.googleplay_converted_region_prices.premium.converted_region_prices["JP"].price
}

# The result has the shape a product's regional configuration takes. Note that
# it moves with exchange rates: a product wired to it like this is repriced
# whenever they do.
resource "googleplay_subscription" "premium" {
  package_name    = "com.example.app"
  product_id      = "premium"
  regions_version = data.googleplay_converted_region_prices.premium.region_version

  listings = {
    "en-US" = { title = "Premium" }
  }

  base_plans = {
    monthly = {
      auto_renewing = {
        billing_period_duration = "P1M"
      }

      regional_configs = {
        for region, converted in data.googleplay_converted_region_prices.premium.converted_region_prices :
        region => {
          price                       = converted.price
          new_subscriber_availability = true
        }
      }

      other_regions_config = {
        usd_price                   = data.googleplay_converted_region_prices.premium.converted_other_regions_price.usd_price
        eur_price                   = data.googleplay_converted_region_prices.premium.converted_other_regions_price.eur_price
        new_subscriber_availability = true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_name` (String) The package name (application id) of the app, for example `com.example.app`. The app must already exist in Play Console: the API cannot create one.
- `price` (Attributes) The price to convert, exclusive of tax. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--price))

### Optional

- `product_tax_category_code` (String) The product tax category code whose tax rates go into the calculation. Left out, the rates of the default category are used.

### Read-Only

- `converted_other_regions_price` (Attributes) The converted prices, exclusive of tax, for regions whose local currency Google Play does not support. They are what a product's other-regions or new-regions configuration takes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted_other_regions_price))
- `converted_region_prices` (Attributes Map) The converted price of each region, by region code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted_region_prices))
- `region_version` (String) The regions version the prices were generated at. It can be passed to a product's `regions_version`.

<a id="nestedatt--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `price`

Required:

- `amount` (String) The amount as a decimal string, for example `"4.99"`. It is converted to the API's units and nanos exactly, never through a floating-point number.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example `USD`.


<a id="nestedatt--converted_other_regions_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted_other_regions_price`

Read-Only:

- `eur_price` (Attributes) The price in EUR. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted_other_regions_price--eur_price))
- `usd_price` (Attributes) The price in USD. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted_other_regions_price--usd_price))

<a id="nestedatt--converted_other_regions_price--eur_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted_other_regions_price.eur_price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount as an exact decimal string, for example `"4.99"`.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.


<a id="nestedatt--converted_other_regions_price--usd_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted_other_regions_price.usd_price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount as an exact decimal string, for example `"4.99"`.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.



<a id="nestedatt--converted_region_prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted_region_prices`

Read-Only:

- `price` (Attributes) The converted price, inclusive of tax. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted_region_prices--price))
- `region_code` (String) The region code, the same as the map key.
- `tax_amount` (Attributes) The tax included in the converted price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--converted_region_prices--tax_amount))

<a id="nestedatt--converted_region_prices--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted_region_prices.price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount as an exact decimal string, for example `"4.99"`.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.


<a id="nestedatt--converted_region_prices--tax_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `converted_region_prices.tax_amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount as an exact decimal string, for example `"4.99"`.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.
